apps.name: SteelFlow: Metal Calculator
apps.description:
SteelFlow turns dimensions into a clear, verifiable metal estimate—and turns that estimate into a client-ready quote.

CALCULATE METAL WEIGHT

Choose a profile, enter dimensions and quantity, and see unit weight, total weight, surface area, volume, and the formula behind the result. SteelFlow supports common profiles including plate and flat bar, round, square, hexagonal and octagonal bar, round, square and rectangular tube, angle, channel, I/H sections, T sections, and custom cross-sectional area.

ESTIMATE REAL PROJECT COST

Price material by kg, lb, meter, foot, or piece. Add waste, processing charges, transport or other fixed fees, markup or margin, and tax. Currency-aware rounding keeps totals practical for real quotes.

BUILD PROJECTS, NOT LOOSE CALCULATIONS

Save multiple material items into a project, duplicate and reorder them, update pricing, and keep every dimension and assumption traceable. See total quantity, weight, material cost, fees, tax, and quote total in one place.

SHARE PROFESSIONAL OUTPUT

Create a polished PDF quote or export a machine-friendly CSV material list. Add company and customer details, terms, validity, and notes before sharing.

MATERIALS AND UNITS THAT FIT YOUR WORK

Use built-in densities for carbon steel, stainless steel, aluminum, copper, brass, titanium and more, or create custom materials. Work in metric or imperial units without rebuilding a calculation.

PRIVATE AND OFFLINE

No account is required. Project and material data stays on your device by default, core calculations work offline, and versioned local backup helps you move or restore your records.

FREE TO START, ONE-TIME PRO UPGRADE

Quick calculations and essential project tools are free. SteelFlow Pro unlocks unlimited projects and items, custom materials, company details and quote terms, CSV export, unbranded PDF quotes, versioned backup, and bulk pricing with one non-consumable purchase—no subscription.

IMPORTANT

Weights and prices are theoretical estimates based on your inputs, reference densities, and common engineering formulas. Verify material grades, current standards, supplier data, drawings, and actual stock before purchasing, fabrication, transport planning, structural design, settlement, or contract use.

钢材与金属型材算重

选择截面，输入尺寸和数量，即时查看单件重量、总重量、表面积、体积与计算公式。支持钢板/扁钢、圆钢、方钢、六角钢、八角钢、圆管、方管、矩形管、角钢、槽钢、工字钢/H 型钢、T 型钢与自定义截面面积。

核算真实项目成本

材料可按 kg、lb、米、英尺或件计价，并计入损耗、加工费、运输费等固定费用、加价率或毛利率与税费。金额按币种规则舍入，适合实际报价。

以项目管理，不再散落计算

把多个材料条目保存到项目，支持复制、排序和更新价格。尺寸、密度、单位与价格来源均可追溯，并统一汇总数量、重量、材料成本、费用、税费和报价总额。

导出专业报价单与清单

生成排版清晰的 PDF 报价单，或导出便于表格软件处理的 CSV 材料清单。分享前可填写公司、客户、条款、有效期与备注。

材料与单位贴合实际工作

内置碳钢、不锈钢、铝、铜、黄铜、钛等常用材料密度，也可以创建自定义材料。支持公制与英制单位切换，无需重新建立计算。

离线可用，默认保护隐私

无需注册账号。项目和材料数据默认保存在本机，核心计算可离线完成，并支持版本化本地备份与恢复。

免费开始，一次买断 Pro

快速计算和基础项目工具免费使用。SteelFlow Pro 通过一次性非消耗型购买解锁无限项目与条目、自定义材料、公司资料与报价条款、CSV 导出、无 SteelFlow 标识的 PDF 报价单、版本化备份和批量定价，不设订阅。

重要说明

重量与价格基于用户输入、参考密度和常用工程公式计算，属于理论估算。正式采购、加工、运输规划、结构设计、结算或合同报价前，请结合材料牌号、现行标准、供应商数据、设计文件和实际库存复核。

买断使用，无需账号，无需登录，无需订阅，无需服务器。核心功能可离线使用，项目、报价和材料数据默认保存在你的设备本地。

适用场景
• 现场快速估算材料重量
• 采购前核算钢材数量和成本
• 给客户制作材料报价单
• 车间下料和加工前准备
• 工程预算和材料清单整理
• 五金店、加工厂、施工队日常办公

重要说明
本 App 的重量、价格、常用型材参考规格和报价结果基于用户输入、内置参考数据和常用工程公式计算，属于理论重量估算，仅供估算和办公辅助使用。正式采购、结算、结构设计、安全校核或合同报价前，请结合现行标准、供应商数据、设计文件和专业人员意见进行复核。

apps.name: SteelFlow: Metal Calculator
apps.description:
SteelFlow turns dimensions into a clear, verifiable metal estimate—and turns that estimate into a client-ready quote.

CALCULATE METAL WEIGHT

Choose a profile, enter dimensions and quantity, and see unit weight, total weight, surface area, volume, and the formula behind the result. SteelFlow supports common profiles including plate and flat bar, round, square, hexagonal and octagonal bar, round, square and rectangular tube, angle, channel, I/H sections, T sections, and custom cross-sectional area.

ESTIMATE REAL PROJECT COST

Price material by kg, lb, meter, foot, or piece. Add waste, processing charges, transport or other fixed fees, markup or margin, and tax. Currency-aware rounding keeps totals practical for real quotes.

BUILD PROJECTS, NOT LOOSE CALCULATIONS

Save multiple material items into a project, duplicate and reorder them, update pricing, and keep every dimension and assumption traceable. See total quantity, weight, material cost, fees, tax, and quote total in one place.

SHARE PROFESSIONAL OUTPUT

Create a polished PDF quote or export a machine-friendly CSV material list. Add company and customer details, terms, validity, and notes before sharing.

MATERIALS AND UNITS THAT FIT YOUR WORK

Use built-in densities for carbon steel, stainless steel, aluminum, copper, brass, titanium and more, or create custom materials. Work in metric or imperial units without rebuilding a calculation.

PRIVATE AND OFFLINE

No account is required. Project and material data stays on your device by default, core calculations work offline, and versioned local backup helps you move or restore your records.

FREE TO START, ONE-TIME PRO UPGRADE

Quick calculations and essential project tools are free. SteelFlow Pro unlocks unlimited projects and items, custom materials, company details and quote terms, CSV export, unbranded PDF quotes, versioned backup, and bulk pricing with one non-consumable purchase—no subscription.

IMPORTANT

Weights and prices are theoretical estimates based on your inputs, reference densities, and common engineering formulas. Verify material grades, current standards, supplier data, drawings, and actual stock before purchasing, fabrication, transport planning, structural design, settlement, or contract use.
